point.title: Agent Chat Orchestration
point.rationale: AgentChatService manages persisted conversations, native thread resume, streaming events, turn-bound tools, and alternative generation through a Codex app-server connection. GenerationCanvasBridge supplies each candidate with an isolated controller behind the same canvas port. This makes chat both an interactive client of canvas tools and a coordinator of independent generated alternatives.

relationships.label: Invokes tools bound to the current chat turn
